def: Tell which integers are bigger. Then put them in order.
defEs: Decir cuál entero es mayor y ponerlos en orden.
alt: Illustration of Compare and Order Integers: Tell which integers are bigger. Then put them in order.

def: A line with numbers in order, left to right.
defEs: Una recta con los números en orden, de izquierda a derecha.
alt: Illustration of Number line: A line with numbers in order, left to right.

def: Look at two amounts. See which is more, less, or the same.
defEs: Mirar dos cantidades para ver cuál es mayor, menor o igual.
alt: Illustration of Compare: Look at two amounts. See which is more, less, or the same.

def: Put numbers from smallest to biggest, or the reverse.
defEs: Poner números del menor al mayor, o al revés.
alt: Illustration of Order: Put numbers from smallest to biggest, or the reverse.

def: The > sign. It shows one number is bigger.
defEs: El signo >. Muestra que un número es mayor.
alt: Illustration of Greater than: The > sign. It shows one number is bigger.

def: The < sign. It shows one number is smaller.
defEs: El signo <. Muestra que un número es menor.
alt: Illustration of Less than: The < sign. It shows one number is smaller.

def: A whole number less than zero, like −5.
defEs: Un número entero menor que cero, como −5.
alt: Illustration of Negative integer: A whole number less than zero, like −5.

def: A whole number or its opposite, like 2 and −2.
defEs: Un número de contar, su opuesto o el cero, como 2, −2 y 0.
alt: Illustration of Integer: A whole number or its opposite, like 2 and −2.

def: A math sentence that compares sides with <, >, ≤, or ≥.
defEs: Una oración matemática que compara lados con <, >, ≤ o ≥.
